title: STEAL A FIGHTER JET
yt_title: How to Steal a Fighter Jet in GTA 6 (Military Base)
hook: Here's how to steal a fighter jet at the GTA 6 military base, and what happens the second you take off.
tips: 1. Steal a jet from the military base at the bottom of the Keys (TGG hlEojE7w0Zw 0:09-0:19 location, 0:175-0:194 get to jets before they box you in; Typical Gamer cyAPzaLcEsM 4092-4200 base, parachute in, jet)
2. Main entrance is packed with guards; alternate route via stunt jump on a dirt bike (TGG only, not on any streamer frame) - description only
3. Body armor (up to three, from an ammunition store) as step one; bank your cash first (TGG 54-129 + Mr Lawrence Hd3QiIsF8Vc: die = lose carried cash) - cash tip description-only
4. Jet weapons: machine gun and missile turret (TGG 226; TG 4210; weapon wheel on frame 4214-4221)
5. Five-star wanted level on takeoff (TGG 216; TG frames 4190+)

parts.text: Here's how to steal a fighter jet in GTA 6. And you'll have five stars the second you take off.
parts.proof: jet in flight, 5 stars on HUD

parts.text: One. Gear up first. Buy body armor at an ammunition store, up to three, and equip it from the wheel for extra health.
parts.label: 1  Body armor
parts.proof: armored vest on character 2473; wheel 'Body armor' item 2476-2482 (TGG 54-82 buy body armor up to three; TG 2472)

parts.text: Two. Find the military base at the bottom of the Keys. The front gate is packed with guards, so skip it and come in from the sky.
parts.label: 2  Military base
parts.proof: seaplane over the base island 4100-4130 (TG 4092 'this is the military base'; TGG 0:09-0:28 bottom of the Keys, gate guards)

parts.text: Three. Fly in over the fence and bail out on your parachute, right above the hangars. The jets are parked out in the open.
parts.label: 3  Bail out

parts.text: Four. Run straight to a jet and get in fast. The military tries to box in your exit, so don't stop to look around.
parts.label: 4  Get in a jet
parts.proof: chute lands by jet 4168; P-996 Lazer prompt 4175 (TGG 175-194 box in the exit; TG 4167 'get me in')

parts.text: Five. Take off straight away. The moment you do, you're at five stars.
parts.label: 5  Take off - 5 stars
parts.proof: takeoff 4182-4198, stars 2 -> 5 on HUD (TGG 216 'five star wanted level')

parts.text: Six. Open the weapon wheel and pick the machine gun or the missile turret. Fighter jets lock on to you fast, so be ready.
parts.label: 6  Weapon wheel

parts.text: That's a fighter jet stolen. Did you make it out alive? Drop a comment and tell me how long you lasted.

desc_steps: 1. Gear up first: buy body armor (up to three) at an ammunition store, equip it, stock up on health items, and bank your cash. If you die you lose the cash you're carrying.
2. Find the military base at the bottom of the Keys. The main entrance is packed with guards.
3. Skip the gate: fly in over the fence and bail out on a parachute above the hangars (shown in the video), or take the side route over the stunt jump on a dirt bike.
4. Run to a jet and get in fast. The military tries to box in your exit.
5. Take off immediately. You get a five-star wanted level.
6. Open the weapon wheel for the machine gun or missile turret. Other jets lock on to you fast.
Tank option: the same side route also gets you to the tanks.

Body armor / stunt-jump route / bank cash are TGG-only or unseen, so they are in the description, not the video.
